# gns3_version (Data Source)

The GNS3 server version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gns3_version" "server" {}

output "gns3_version" {
  value = data.gns3_version.server.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) REST API generation the provider uses, `v2` in this release.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the server runs with `--local` (local paths allowed).
- `version` (String) Server version, for example `2.2.52`.
